name: Avie
tagline: AI WhatsApp receptionist, scheduling and CRM for clinics in Brazil
description:
Avie is an AI receptionist for private medical and healthcare clinics in Brazil that communicate with patients through WhatsApp. It answers routine questions using the clinic’s own information, explains appointments and prices, helps book, reschedule and cancel appointments, and hands conversations to the clinic team when human judgment is needed. Staff can take over a conversation and return it to the AI with instructions.

Avie Atende includes appointment scheduling, waiting lists, reminders, configurable WhatsApp CRM programs, a clinic website on its own domain, and monthly reporting. It is intended for solo practitioners and clinic teams working in Brazilian Portuguese. Implementation is handled by the Avie team. Avie Cuida adds electronic medical records, AI-assisted consultation notes and patient and payment management. Avie Cresce adds managed digital-presence services.

Avie Atende starts at R$1,350 per month plus a one-time R$2,700 implementation fee. Avie Cuida costs R$1,530 per month plus R$2,550 implementation; Avie Cresce is quoted individually. Current details are at https://avie.me/precos. Product information in English: https://avie.me/en.
